2.t: By the Book that makes things clear;-

3.t: We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).

4.t: In the (Night) is made distinct every affair of wisdom,

5.t: By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) send (revelations),

6.t: As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);

7.t: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, if ye (but) have an assured faith.

8.t: There is no god but He: It is He Who gives life and gives death,- The Lord and Cherisher to you and your earliest ancestors.

9.t: Yet they play about in doubt.

10.t: Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,

11.t: Enveloping the people: this will be a Penalty Grievous.

12.t: (They will say:) "Our Lord! remove the Penalty from us, for we do really believe!"

13.t: How shall the message be (effectual) for them, seeing that an Messenger explaining things clearly has (already) come to them,-

14.t: Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"

15.t: We shall indeed remove the Penalty for a while, (but) truly ye will revert (to your ways).

16.t: One day We shall seize you with a mighty onslaught: We will indeed (then) exact Retribution!

17.t: We did, before them, try the people of Pharaoh: there came to them a messenger most honourable,

18.t: Saying: "Restore to me the Servants of Allah: I am to you an messenger worthy of all trust;

19.t: "And be not arrogant as against Allah: for I come to you with authority manifest.

20.t: "For me, I have sought safety with my Lord and your Lord, against your injuring me.

21.t: "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."

22.t: (But they were aggressive:) then he cried to his Lord: "These are indeed a people given to sin."

23.t: (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.

24.t: "And leave the sea as a furrow (divided): for they are a host (destined) to be drowned."

25.t: How many were the gardens and springs they left behind,

27.t: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!

28.t: Thus (was their end)! And We made other people inherit (those things)!

29.t: And neither heaven nor earth shed a tear over them: nor were they given a respite (again).

30.t: We did deliver aforetime the Children of Israel from humiliating Punishment,

31.t: Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he was arrogant (even) among inordinate transgressors.

32.t: And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,

33.t: And granted them Signs in which there was a manifest trial

34.t: As to these (Quraish), they say forsooth:

35.t: "There is nothing beyond our first death, and we shall not be raised again.

36.t: "Then bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"

37.t: What! Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who were before them? We destroyed them because they were guilty of sin.

38.t: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, merely in (idle) sport:

39.t: We created them not except for just ends: but most of them do not understand.

40.t: Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-

41.t: The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,

42.t: Except such as receive Allah's Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

44.t: Will be the food of the Sinful,-

45.t: Like molten brass; it will boil in their insides.

46.t: Like the boiling of scalding water.

47.t: (A voice will cry: "Seize ye him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire!

48.t: "Then pour over his head the Penalty of Boiling Water,

49.t: "Taste thou (this)! Truly wast thou mighty, full of honour!

50.t: "Truly this is what ye used to doubt!"

51.t: As to the Righteous (they will be) in a position of Security,

53.t: Dressed in fine silk and in rich brocade, they will face each other;

54.t: So; and We shall join them to fair women with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes.

55.t: There can they call for every kind of fruit in peace and security;

56.t: Nor will they there taste Death, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire,-

57.t: As a Bounty from thy Lord! that will be the supreme achievement!

58.t: Verily, We have made this (Qur'an) easy, in thy tongue, in order that they may give heed.

59.t: So wait thou and watch; for they (too) are waiting.
